n41167.source: Flavius Claudius Julianus, Contra Galilaeos, ed. Wilmer Cave Wright, London 1923 (Perseus)

n41167.source: Demosthenes, Adversus Leptinem, ed. Samuel Henry Butcher, Oxford 1907 (Perseus)

n41167.source: Polybius, Historiae, ed. Theodor Büttner-Wobst, Leipzig 1893 (Perseus)

n41174.source: Plutarchus, Brutus, ed. Bernadotte Perrin, Cambridge, Mass. 1918 (Perseus)
